BiblicalUsage: Chacon means powerful, strong — and both times it falls. Isaiah says the strong will be as tow, burning with his own work, and Amos says God destroyed the Amorite who was strong as the oaks.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe human strength is tow before a spark, and the oak-strong Amorite is the proof.
